## Type of change

- [ ] New or updated algorithm (`src/ctai/algorithms/`, `docs/algorithms/`)
- [ ] Shared core (checker, problem, budget, submitter) — requires owner review
- [ ] Runner or evaluation
- [ ] Data or documentation
- [ ] CI / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes
- [ ] Feasible on all six practice scenarios (`python -m ctai solve data/practice/<file>.json -a <id>`)
- [ ] Algorithm note updated with idea, pseudocode, complexity, parameters, seed handling,
      limitations, dependencies, both modes
- [ ] Work is counted as one unit per candidate evaluation (`docs/interface.md`)
- [ ] No new third-party dependency
